name: 候補件数を示す複合クイックフィルター
prompt:
Recreate only the monday.com Quick filters panel shown in the primary original crop. Match its 1070:580 aspect ratio (about 1.84:1), rounded white panel, header and footer dividers, and broad whitespace above the filter chips. Exclude the table behind the panel. No Japanese mock exists; use the original crop as the geometry authority and localize interface text.

Header, left to right: bold 「クイックフィルター」, muted 「3件中3件のタスクを表示」, a small circled question-mark help icon. At the far right show 「すべてクリア」 and an outlined 「新しいビューとして保存」 button. Preserve the source spacing.

In the main body, keep four full filter columns in this order with headings 「担当者」, 「ステータス」, 「日付」, 「週数」. Preserve the visible count badges and colored dots/avatars. Person rows: yellow JD avatar and truncated 「自分（dynam…」 with count 1; yellow JD avatar, 「Jane Doe」 with count 1; blue JS avatar, 「John Smith」 with count 1; outline avatar, 「未割り当て」 with count 1. Status rows with their source dots and count 1: 「すべて完了ラベル」 (green/yellow dots), 「作業中」 (orange), 「停滞中」 (red), 「完了」 (green), 「レビュー準備中…」 (blue). Date rows, each with a small dash at the right: 「期限超過」, 「期限内に完了」, 「期限超過で完了」, 「今日」, 「明日」. Weeks rows: 「3」 with count 1, 「0.5」 with count 1, 「1」 with count 1, and 「空白」 with no count.

At the extreme left edge, retain the source’s narrow clipped sliver of a previous filter column, its three partial gray chips with right-aligned 1 counts, and the left-facing carousel chevron over that area. Do not invent or complete the hidden labels. Keep the filter chips pale gray with rounded corners, aligned rows, source column widths, subtle text and whitespace. At the bottom, preserve the divider and left-aligned footer action 「詳細フィルターに切り替え」. Do not add rows, extra headings, cards or table content.
reviewNotes: LH09-0261 v001 compared with the exact source crop. It preserves the filter groups, visible rows/counts, and panel proportions. Material visual drift: Clear all, Save as new view and the footer action are bright blue although the source uses neutral dark text and a gray outline; title/column headings are heavier than the source; the left carousel chevron sits in an added circular button. Status: needs-correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
